subject.title: Feature Request: Add MathJax/LaTeX Support to Control UI

question: Should OpenClaw accept first-party Control UI math rendering in core, and if so which renderer/config/security shape should be sponsored?
rationale: Current main does not implement the feature, but the remaining decision adds optional core UI dependency and untrusted-output rendering behavior that automation should not accept by default.

options.title: Sponsor one core implementation
options.body: Review one open KaTeX/MathJax PR or a narrower successor to completion with dependency/security acceptance and real Control UI proof.

options.title: Defer to extension/API design
options.body: Keep core markdown unchanged for now and define a plugin/API path only if current extension points cannot safely provide math rendering.

options.title: Close as not planned
options.body: Decline first-party math rendering for now and close the related candidate PRs and duplicates with the product rationale.

recommendation.title: Sponsor one core implementation
recommendation.body: Review one open KaTeX/MathJax PR or a narrower successor to completion with dependency/security acceptance and real Control UI proof.

likelyOwner.reason: He has original/recent Control UI renderer history and adjacent config/dependency ownership signals for a core product decision.
